description: Current codegen and validation strategy for AutoWaterSimu Next contracts.

typescript.reason: Web UI consumes the Go Compute API through OpenAPI; generated TS types must stay isolated behind frontend services.

openapi.reason: OpenAPI is the current API-facing projection used by the generated Compute TS client.

go.reason: The Go API already owns HTTP DTOs and validates contract payloads at runtime; generated Go contract types are deferred until package boundaries are split.

python.reason: The worker executes schema-validated payloads and focused transform helpers; generated Python types are deferred until they remove duplicated runtime checks.

rust.drift_gate: desktop Rust tests and project package smoke
rust.reason: Desktop currently owns local runtime/package DTOs and does not consume every contract directly; generated Rust types need a scoped package-schema plan first.

current_non_goals: Do not commit generated Go, Python, or Rust contract types in this slice.
Do not replace runtime JSON Schema validation with generated type checks alone.
Do not move generated frontend Compute client imports into route or component code.
